guitar.modelsText: "Arm the Homeless" guitar / Fender Telecaster / Squier Strat-style guitars
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Tom Morello's custom "Arm the Homeless" guitar (Strat-style with humbucker) is famous, along with his use of toggle-switch-modified Telecasters.
guitar.notes: Very well documented — should not have been unknown.

tone.target: dry aggressive riff distortion with tight low end and sharp mid punch
tone.profile: dry aggressive riff distortion with tight low end and sharp mid punch
tone.summary: A high-gain distortion chain (Distortion -> Boost) feeding into a powerful British amp model (UK 800) paired with a robust 4x12 cabinet to achieve the required dry, aggressive, and percussive riff tone.
corrections: lean more toward dry hard rock distortion than fuzz
